title: Where/how can I watch more Jun Kurosawa shorts?

commenti.body:
15 of them (most being 1080p) are available on private trackers. It's hard to get invites but a kind soul may upload them for you somewhere.

I didn't know that director but he looks interesting. Thanks for pointing him out.

well they're only short excerpts but KRAUT Film's vimeo channel has a lot of Jun's work
https://vimeo.com/search?q=%E9%BB%92%E6%BE%A4%E6%BD%A4

as other anon said someone could grab from a private and upload for you but I don't have access to those files.
